description: This file defines the ViewsBlock class for Drupal, providing a plugin for rendering views as blocks with methods for building, configuration, validation, and rendering logic.

classes.name: ViewsBlock
classes.description: A Drupal plugin class providing a block that displays a view, with methods for building, configuration, validation, and rendering.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the renderable array for the block, processing view arguments, applying pre-render callbacks, and setting titles.

methods.name: getConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves the block's configuration, including label settings.

methods.name: defaultConfiguration
methods.description: Provides default configuration for the block, including cache settings.

methods.name: blockForm
methods.description: Returns the form for configuring the block.

methods.name: blockSubmit
methods.description: Handles submission of the block configuration form.

methods.name: getMachineNameSuggestion
methods.description: Generates a machine name suggestion for the block based on the view.
